# PROJECT 3 — FINAL DEMO INTEGRATION
One visible, live orchestration path. Workflow 60 owns 53 and 61–66. Workflow 54 is called in bounded non-public-gap mode so it cannot destabilize primary research.

parameters.jsCode: const incoming = items[0]?.json || {}; const hasLiveInput = typeof incoming.organization_name === 'string' && incoming.organization_name.trim() && typeof incoming.website === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(incoming.website) && typeof incoming.country === 'string' && incoming.country.trim(); if (hasLiveInput) { const organization_name = incoming.organization_name.trim(); const website = incoming.website.trim(); const country = incoming.country.trim(); const supplied = incoming.run_context && typeof incoming.run_context === 'object' ? incoming.run_context : {}; return [{ json: { organization_name, website, country, query: typeof incoming.query === 'string' && incoming.query.trim() ? incoming.query.trim() : `${organization_name} annual report audited financial statements revenue funding grants donations impact outcomes`, correlation_id: incoming.correlation_id, transport_intake: incoming.transport_intake, run_context: { ...supplied, run_id: supplied.run_id || `RUN-PROJECT3-${Date.now()}`, organization: { ...(supplied.organization || {}), name: organization_name, website, country }, current_challenge: supplied.current_challenge || incoming.current_challenge || 'Prepare a public-data-first pre-engagement diagnostic.', uploaded_document_refs: Array.isArray(supplied.uploaded_document_refs) ? supplied.uploaded_document_refs : [], status: 'created', started_at: supplied.started_at || new Date().toISOString(), errors: Array.isArray(supplied.errors) ? supplied.errors : [] } } }]; } return [{ json: { organization_name: 'GiveDirectly', website: 'https://www.givedirectly.org', country: 'United States', query: 'GiveDirectly annual report audited financial statements revenue funding grants donations impact outcomes', run_context: { run_id: `RUN-PROJECT3-${Date.now()}`, organization: { name: 'GiveDirectly', website: 'https://www.givedirectly.org', country: 'United States', mission_area: 'direct cash transfers' }, current_challenge: 'Assess revenue resilience and impact evidence without converting outputs into outcomes or impact.', uploaded_document_refs: [], status: 'created', started_at: new Date().toISOString(), errors: [] } } }];return [{ json: { organization_name: 'GiveDirectly', website: 'https://www.givedirectly.org', country: 'United States', query: 'GiveDirectly annual report audited financial statements revenue funding grants donations impact outcomes', run_context: { run_id: `RUN-PROJECT3-${Date.now()}`, organization: { name: 'GiveDirectly', website: 'https://www.givedirectly.org', country: 'United States', mission_area: 'direct cash transfers' }, current_challenge: 'Assess revenue resilience and impact evidence without converting outputs into outcomes or impact.', uploaded_document_refs: [], status: 'created', started_at: new Date().toISOString(), errors: [] } } }];
const base = $('DEMO_INPUT__GIVEDIRECTLY').first().json; const search = items[0]?.json || {}; return [{ json: { ...base, run_context: search.run_context || base.run_context, research_21: search } }];

const base = $('DEMO_INPUT__GIVEDIRECTLY').first().json; const search = $('EXECUTE__21_WEB_SEARCH').first().json; const website = items[0]?.json || {}; const candidates = []; const add = (url, title, discovered_by) => { if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(String(url || '')) && !candidates.some(x => x.url === url)) candidates.push({ url, title: title || 'Public document', discovered_by }); }; for (const result of search.search?.results || []) if (/\.pdf(?:[?#]|$)|annual|financial|audit|report/i.test(`${result.url} ${result.title}`)) add(result.url, result.title, 'web_search'); for (const link of website.website_context?.report_links || []) add(link.url || link, link.title, 'website_extraction'); add('https://www.givedirectly.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/FY2023-GiveDirectly-Audit-Final-FS-Public-Disclosure.pdf', 'GiveDirectly FY2023 audited financial statements', 'public_data'); return [{ json: { run_context: base.run_context, organization: base.run_context.organization, document_candidates: candidates.slice(0, 4), research_21: search, research_22: website } }];

const base = $('DEMO_INPUT__GIVEDIRECTLY').first().json; const search = $('EXECUTE__21_WEB_SEARCH').first().json; const website = $('EXECUTE__22_WEBSITE_EXTRACTION').first().json; const documentsOut = items[0]?.json || {}; const all = [...(search.sources || []), ...(website.sources || []), ...(documentsOut.sources || [])]; const byUrl = new Map(); for (const source of all) { const key = String(source.url || '').replace(/\/$/, '').toLowerCase(); if (key && !byUrl.has(key)) byUrl.set(key, source); } const sources = [...byUrl.values()].map((source, index) => ({ ...source, source_id: `SRC-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}` })); const sourceIdByUrl = new Map(sources.map(source => [String(source.url || '').replace(/\/$/, '').toLowerCase(), source.source_id])); const documents = (documentsOut.documents || []).map(doc => ({ ...doc, source_id: sourceIdByUrl.get(String(doc.url || '').replace(/\/$/, '').toLowerCase()) || doc.source_id })); return [{ json: { run_context: base.run_context, sources, documents, research: { web_search: { controlled_state: search.controlled_state, query: search.search?.query, result_count: search.sources?.length || 0 }, website: { controlled_state: website.controlled_state, source_count: website.sources?.length || 0 }, documents: { controlled_state: documentsOut.controlled_state, document_count: documents.length } }, controlled_state: sources.length ? 'research_ready' : 'insufficient_public_sources', errors: [...(search.errors || []), ...(website.errors || []), ...(documentsOut.errors || [])] } }];

const paola = items[0]?.json || {}; const research = $('MERGE_AND_DEDUP_RESEARCH').first().json; return [{ json: { ...paola, sources: research.sources || paola.sources || [], documents: research.documents || [], rag_context: paola.rag_context || $('EXECUTE__40_RAG_RETRIEVAL').first().json.rag_context } }];

const revenue = $('EXECUTE__51_REVENUE_RESILIENCE').first().json; const impact = items[0]?.json || {}; const research = $('MERGE_AND_DEDUP_RESEARCH').first().json; const unique = (rows, key) => [...new Map(rows.filter(Boolean).map(row => [row[key], row])).values()]; const evidence = unique([...(revenue.evidence || []), ...(impact.impact_evidence || [])], 'evidence_id'); const findings = unique([...(revenue.findings || []), ...(impact.findings || [])], 'finding_id'); const unknowns = unique([...(revenue.unknowns || []), ...(impact.unknowns || [])].map((u, i) => ({ ...u, unknown_id: u.unknown_id || `UNK-MERGED-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}` })), 'unknown_id'); return [{ json: { run_context: revenue.run_context || impact.run_context, sources: research.sources || [], evidence, findings, unknowns, contradictions: unique([...(revenue.contradictions || []), ...(impact.contradictions || [])], 'contradiction_id'), rag_metadata: { retrieval_run_id: revenue.rag_metadata?.retrieval_run_id || impact.rag_metadata?.retrieval_run_id || null, domains: ['revenue_resilience', 'impact_evidence'], retrieved_context_ids: unique([...(revenue.rag_metadata?.retrieved_context_ids || []), ...(impact.rag_metadata?.retrieved_context_ids || [])].map(id => ({ id })), 'id').map(x => x.id) }, documents: research.documents || [], paola_states: { revenue_resilience: revenue.controlled_state, impact_evidence: impact.controlled_state }, research: research.research, controlled_state: findings.length ? 'paola_analysis_ready' : 'insufficient_evidence' } }];

const payload = items[0].json; return [{ json: { ...payload, handoff_version: 'project3-demo-v1', missing_evidence_request: { gap_id: 'GAP-DEMO-INTERNAL-001', domain: 'operations_cx', question: 'What happens internally after a stakeholder submits an application form?', gap_type: 'internal_handoff', current_evidence_ids: [], retry_count: 0, max_retries: 1, reason_for_retry: 'Public sources do not describe the internal follow-up process.' } } }];

const handoff = $('BUILD_CANONICAL_HANDOFF').first().json; const gap = items[0]?.json || {}; return [{ json: { ...handoff, evidence_gap_research: { controlled_state: gap.controlled_state, can_public_research_answer: gap.can_public_research_answer, requires_client_validation: gap.requires_client_validation, searched: false, unknown_preserved: gap.controlled_state === 'unknown_preserved' } } }];

const paola = $('FINAL_PAOLA_HANDOFF').first().json; const gretel = items[0]?.json || {}; const counts = { sources: paola.sources?.length || 0, evidence: paola.evidence?.length || 0, findings: paola.findings?.length || 0, unknowns: paola.unknowns?.length || 0, hypotheses: gretel.hypotheses?.length || 0, diagnoses: gretel.diagnoses?.length || 0, recommendations: gretel.recommendations?.length || 0, kpis: gretel.kpis?.length || 0, validation_questions: gretel.validation_questions?.length || 0, roadmap_actions: gretel.roadmap_actions?.length || 0 }; const finding = (paola.findings || []).find(f => (f.evidence_ids || []).length) || paola.findings?.[0]; const evidence = (paola.evidence || []).find(e => (finding?.evidence_ids || []).includes(e.evidence_id)); const source = (paola.sources || []).find(s => (evidence?.source_ids || []).includes(s.source_id)); const hypothesis = (gretel.hypotheses || []).find(h => (h.finding_ids || []).includes(finding?.finding_id)); const diagnosis = (gretel.diagnoses || []).find(d => (d.hypothesis_ids || []).includes(hypothesis?.hypothesis_id)); const recommendation = (gretel.recommendations || []).find(r => (r.diagnosis_ids || []).includes(diagnosis?.diagnosis_id)); const roadmap = (gretel.roadmap_actions || []).find(r => (r.recommendation_ids || []).includes(recommendation?.recommendation_id)); const trace = { source_id: source?.source_id || null, evidence_id: evidence?.evidence_id || null, finding_id: finding?.finding_id || null, hypothesis_id: hypothesis?.hypothesis_id || null, diagnosis_id: diagnosis?.diagnosis_id || null, recommendation_id: recommendation?.recommendation_id || null, kpi_name: recommendation?.kpi?.name || gretel.kpis?.[0]?.name || null, roadmap_action_id: roadmap?.roadmap_action_id || null }; const traceComplete = Object.values(trace).every(Boolean); return [{ json: { run_context: paola.run_context, organization: paola.run_context?.organization, controlled_state: traceComplete ? 'demo_ready' : 'partial_demo', counts, trace, research: paola.research, paola_states: paola.paola_states, evidence_gap_research: paola.evidence_gap_research, guardrails: { source_is_not_evidence: true, outputs_not_promoted_to_outcomes_or_impact: true, absence_of_public_evidence_is_not_evidence_of_absence: true, unknowns_preserved: true }, paola: { sources: paola.sources, evidence: paola.evidence, findings: paola.findings, unknowns: paola.unknowns, contradictions: paola.contradictions }, transformation: gretel } }];
